babylon.name: Babylon
babylon.dict: Named once, as the place where sorcery was learned from the two angels Harut and Marut (2:102).

badr.name: Badr
badr.dict: "God had given you victory at Badr, when you were weak" (3:123): the one battle against the Meccans that the Quran names. By tradition it was fought in 624, southwest of Medina; surah 8 is tied to it.
